parts.text: In a COPD patient, what would be the most likely organism?

cohort_answer.text: Vaginal smear: No BV. Yeast present. Sputum smear: ++WBC, rare epithelial cells, +GNB.

questions.question: URTI in old guy with COPD (or a 26 week old baby in peds exam) in contact with a 2 year old who had a cold

parts.text: What diagnostic test will give result within 24 hrs?

cohort_answer.text: Diagnostic test: RPP (respiratory pathogen panel). Viruses: Influenza; Rhinovirus; Parainfluenza; RSV; Human metapneumovirus; Adenovirus.
